An isolated '''chain''' of islands existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] that was home to two unique [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;the [[Wingmaw/Legends|wingmaw]] and its primary predator, the [[Balmorran maweater]]. Around [[4250 BBY]], explorers unknowingly brought both creatures to the Balmorran mainland, which gave rise to large populations of both predator and prey on the mainland until the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war, Imperial [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombardment]] wiped out the maweater population on both the mainland and the islands.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Balmorran island chain was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the wingmaw in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
